title: PIXL 8000 Blueberry Raspberry Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blueberry Raspberry from PIXL 8000 is a familiar yet irresistible blend of two classic berries. Juicy Blueberry forms the base, while sweet-tart Raspberry lifts the finish with a touch of brightness. Each pod comes prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is accompanied by a 10ml refill reservoir. When used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this setup delivers up to 8000 puffs with smooth, flavourful vapour courtesy of mesh coil technology. Ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, this pod is draw-activated and easy to use. Insert the pod into your device, activate Boost Mode for denser clouds, and enjoy a reliable all-day vape. One of the most popular choices in the PIXL 8000 collection.
